claims.text: Deep learning models for fake news detection on social networks are structured as either unimodal or multimodal framework modalities.
Fake news detection using deep learning models suffers from limitations due to low-resource language datasets.

evidence.description: The systematic review focuses on unimodal (single model analysis) and multimodal (integration of multiple models) deep learning modalities for fake news detection.
Review findings highlight the limitations of datasets available for low-resource languages in fake news detection.

methodologies.name: Systematic Literature Review
methodologies.description: A systematic review following predefined selection criteria to analyze unimodal and multimodal deep learning modalities for fake news detection in social networks.

limitations.text: Datasets for low-resource languages are limited for training and evaluation of deep learning fake news detection models.

future_work.text: Explore future directions for deep learning models combined with different fact-checking techniques.
Investigate fake news detection methodologies in the context of large language models.
